proposed_claims.claim_text: Express delivery normally arrives in one to two business days after dispatch.
proposed_claims.supporting_excerpt: Standard delivery normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch. Express delivery normally arrives in one to two business days after dispatch. Orders placed after the daily fulfillment cutoff are processed on the next business day. Alaska, Hawaii, and remote locations may have different availability and estimates shown at checkout.
